selectedTopic: Corrective action, lot disposition and reinspection after a failed free-weight pre-shipment inspection
selectionReason: A high-intent buyer problem with no dedicated live owner. Existing pages explain how to inspect and classify defects; this guide owns the next decision: hold release, define scope, contain, sort or rework, verify cause, reinspect and issue written release without treating one failed sample as proof about every unit.

limitations: Quora pages were not used because automated verification was blocked; no claim depends on Quora.
Reddit was used only for buyer wording and recurring questions, never as technical or contractual proof.
No universal rule is claimed for payment, reinspection cost, deviation authority or supplier liability; signed terms control the commercial decision.
No customer, project, quantity, price, MOQ, lead time, test result, certification or factory performance claim is made.
Images are conceptual editorial scenes, not evidence of an actual order, failed lot, customer, inspection visit or factory event.
